newsitem.title: CHINA: Shui Hing approached on stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Shui Hing approached on stake sale.

text.p: Shui Hing Co Ltd said on Tuesday its 71 percent controlling shareholder Daniel Koo and his family had been approached by third parties regarding acquiring a stake in the company.
"They have received a number of approaches from certain parties with regard to acquiring an interest in the company," the company said in a statement.
It said the parties include a group which was believed to have a China background.
"These discussions are at a very preliminary stage," it said
Shui Hing said the Koo family had no made any decision with regard to disposing of their interest and it was not clear as to whether the sale would involve a change in control of the company.
Shares of the department store operator rose HK$2.05 or 21.6 percent to HK$11.55 at midday after they hit a year high of HK$12.30.
